name: Tatewaki Shiima
source:
—Revenge—

A 4th-year student at Marenis University.
A sensible person with a gentle demeanor who works part-time as a librarian and dormitory supervisor at Marenis High School.
He is caring and soft-spoken, but also has a side that observes his surroundings calmly.
He has a good sense of money and strong practical living skills.

"I'm not a teacher, so take it easy."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=4]official website[/url]]
